## Subjects Comparison

Which statement is correct?
options: `Subject` stores last value automatically for new subscribers
`BehaviorSubject` requires an initial value and emits current/latest value to new subscribers
`ReplaySubject` can emit only one value ever
All three behave exactly the same
correctAnswer: `BehaviorSubject` requires an initial value and emits current/latest value to new subscribers

## tap and pipe

Why is `tap()` commonly used inside `pipe()`?
options: To perform side effects like logging, debugging, analytics without changing emitted data
To convert Observable into Promise only
correctAnswer: To perform side effects like logging, debugging, analytics without changing emitted data

## Unsubscribe Multiple Streams

A component has many subscriptions. When the component is destroyed, all subscriptions should stop using a single pattern.

### Which approach is commonly used?
options: Use `takeUntil(destroy$)` in streams, then call `destroy$.next()` and `destroy$.complete()` in `ngOnDestroy()`
correctAnswer: Use `takeUntil(destroy$)` in streams, then call `destroy$.next()` and `destroy$.complete()` in `ngOnDestroy()`
